This coheres with the source-record TAS retail real-estate platform but does not prove TAS/KLI product mapping or historical availability for this undated record. Adopt AI provisionally on explicit product-family evidence, weak/forced for applicability. This differs from the labeler's non-AI proposal.
ai_type_rationale: Location intelligence, GIS, and market planning remain meaningful without the assistant; AI augments them.

issues: AI applicability to exact TAS product and represented historical version remains uncertain.

sources.excerpt: Kalibrate Location Intelligence (KLI), the premier location intelligence platform for retail, restaurant, and healthcare brands developed by Kalibrate, is revolutionizing real estate decision-making with the launch of its AI-powered assistant. ... the introduction of an AI tool into KLI will allow clients to make those decisions in a much more efficient way.
